memberdef.name: CASE
memberdef.initializer: case Attribute::ATTRNAME: { \ if (AANAME::isImpliedByIR(A, IRP, AK, IgnoreSubsumingPositions)) \ return IsKnown = true; \ if (!QueryingAA) \ return false; \ const auto *AA = A.getAAFor<AANAME>(*QueryingAA, IRP, DepClass); \ if (AAPtr) \ *AAPtr = reinterpret_cast<const AAType *>(AA); \ if (!AA || !AA->isAssumed(__VA_ARGS__)) \ return false; \ IsKnown = AA->isKnown(__VA_ARGS__); \ return true; \ }
